overview:
About the tour:
Embark on a 6-day Bali escape blending natural beauty, cultural heritage, and romantic indulgence. Begin in Ubud and explore ancient sites like Goa Gajah or vibrant attractions like Waterbom Bali. Witness the stunning Tegallalang Rice Terraces, swing above the jungle, and cool off at the cascading Tegenungan Waterfall. Continue your adventure with an ATV ride en route to lively Kuta, where a candlelight dinner awaits. Sail across turquoise waters to Nusa Penida’s dramatic coastlines and snorkel in its marine paradise. Rejuvenate with a soothing Balinese massage before soaking in clifftop views at Uluwatu Temple and experiencing the mesmerizing Kecak Fire Dance. This tour offers a perfect blend of thrill, tranquility, and timeless romance.

know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

When visiting Nusa Penida, please be aware that any entry fees, retribution fees, or island access charges are not included in your package. These charges will need to be paid directly at the location by each guest.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at the airport, board your transfer and get driven to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can relax or explore the city on your own. You can visit Goa Gajah, the mystical ‘Elephant Cave’ with intricate sacred carvings, or head to Bali Bird Park to encounter vibrant exotic species in lush habitats. For thrill-seekers, cool off at Waterbom Bali, a world-class waterpark renowned for its exciting rides and tropical charm.

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen
days.desc: Today, enjoy a complimentary floating breakfast, a unique indulgence to start your morning in true Balinese style. Then, enjoy a journey through Central Bali on a vintage Volkswagen car, blending classic charm with countryside views. Feel the rush of unlimited rides on the iconic Bali Swing, soaring over lush valleys, before visiting the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall. Also, visit Tirta Empul Temple, famed for its sacred spring pools, & marvel at the UNESCO-listed Tegallalang Rice Terrace.

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: ATV Ride Experience | Visit to Cretya Ubud | Transfer to Kuta
days.desc: Post check-out, get driven to indulge in an adrenaline-pumping ATV ride, navigating Bali’s rugged trails, rice fields, & lush jungle paths for a thrilling adventure. Then, get driven to Cretya Ubud, a spectacular jungle club where infinity pools, tropical views, and a lively ambience make it the perfect spot to relax and recharge. Later, get driven to Kuta, famed for its golden beaches, bustling markets, and vibrant nightlife. On arrival, check in to your hotel and enjoy your overnight stay.

items.title: ATV Adventure in Bali - Tandem ATV Ride (Dual Rider)
Cretya Ubud, Bali - Visit to Cretya Ubud with Transfers

days.title: Watersports at Tenjung Benoa | Visit to Melasti Beach Tour | Uluwatu Temple Tour with Kecak Fire & Dance Show | Kuta Market Visit
days.desc: This morning, set out for Tanjung Benoa, Bali’s adventure hotspot, where you can choose from thrilling watersports like jet skiing, parasailing, and banana boat rides. After a delicious lunch, continue to Melasti Beach, famed for its pristine sands and dramatic limestone cliffs. Later, visit the iconic Uluwatu Temple, perched high above the ocean, and explore the vibrant Kuta Market. Later, get driven to the Tropical Temptation Beach Club for an unforgettable evening by the sea.

items.title: Day Trip to Uluwatu Temple - Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach + Uluwatu Temple Tour + Melasti Beach + Kuta Market with Lunch
Lounge by the infinity pools with ocean views

days.title: Full Day Nusa Penida West Tour with Paluang Cliff | Balinese Massage
days.desc: Today, set out for a west coast adventure as you get driven to Sanur Port and board a speedboat to Nusa Penida. Once there, get driven to the iconic Kelingking Beach, famed for its T-Rex–shaped cliff. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool, and admire the dramatic coastal arch at Broken Bay. Stop at Paluang Cliff for panoramic views of Kelingking before unwinding at Crystal Bay’s golden sands. Later, indulge in a soothing Balinese massage, the perfect end to your day.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and proceed to the airport for your onward journey. As you board your flight, bid farewell to the island of Bali, carrying cherished memories of its serene temples, cascading waterfalls, thrilling adventures, and golden sunsets. Though your tour comes to an end, the warmth, charm, and beauty of Bali will linger long after your return, leaving you with unforgettable experiences to treasure for a lifetime.
